# Project NEO — old → new migration matrix

**Generated by measurement, not by memory.** Route inventory taken from `app/`,
weights taken by following each route file into the components it imports (the
route files are thin wrappers, so measuring them alone understates the work by
roughly 10x).

- legacy top-level routes: **71**
- already covered or mapped into NEO: **29**
- not yet in NEO: **42**

## C. What the gap list actually means

The 42 rows in section B are **not 42 features**. Measured, they collapse into a
much smaller number of real capabilities:

### C1. The "Center" family — ONE pattern, 11 validated datasets

`/manufacturing/`, `/authorizations/`, `/toolkit/`, `/playbooks/`, `/migration/`,
`/integration/`, `/config/`, `/debugging/`, `/abap/`, `/blueprints/`, `/fiori/`
all render the same two components — `CenterHeader` + `CenterIndexGrid` — over a
different dataset in `data/centers/`. They weigh 16KB each because they share
those components, not because each is 16KB of unique work.

| dataset | items | has ECC→S/4 block |
|---|---|---|
| debugging | 13 | yes |
| fiori | 12 | yes |
| abap | 11 | yes |
| config | 11 | yes |
| toolkit | 8 | yes |
| migration | 7 | yes |
| integration | 6 | yes |
| manufacturing | 6 | yes |
| process-auth | 6 | yes |
| blueprints | 5 | yes |
| playbooks | 4 | yes |
| **total** | **84** | |

Each item is a typed `CenterItem` with structured sections (מטרה / מתי להשתמש /
צ'ק-ליסט / מלכודות נפוצות / אימות QA) plus an `eccS4` migration block. This is
validated SAP content and falls squarely under the rule that nothing may
silently disappear.

**Migration shape: one NEO "Centers" surface + one detail route, driven by the
existing datasets.** Not eleven builds. This is the single largest genuine gap
and the highest-value next unit of work.

### C2. Frozen by instruction, not a gap

`/sap-infrastructure/` (187KB) is the legacy production surface and is under a
standing freeze. NEO replaces it piecewise; it is not migrated wholesale.

### C3. Needs a keep / retire decision (not yet made)

`/brain/`, `/story/`, `/onboarding/`, `/offline/`, `/privacy/`, `/import/`,
`/connector/`, `/delivery/`, `/alm/`, `/verification/`, `/qa-testing/`,
`/quality-audit/`, `/s4-readiness/`, `/evolution/`, `/notes-graph/`,
`/lineage/`, `/impact/`, `/graph/`, `/workbench/`, `/process-explorer/`,
`/solutions/`, `/resolution/`, `/guides/`, `/domain/`, `/oic/`, `/apps/`,
`/sap-notes/`, `/security/`, `/process/`, `/mrp/`, `/migration-cockpit/`.

Several of these are experiments or SEO landing pages rather than product
surfaces. **No decision has been taken and none of them has been deleted.** Each
needs an explicit migrate / replace / retire call before the old site can be
switched off.

## D. Data-consistency bugs found while auditing

| bug | status |
|---|---|
| Sidebar "ספרייה דיגיטלית" showed **10** while `/neo/books/` showed **11** — the sidebar counted `LIBRARY_STATS` from `data/library.ts`, the registry the frozen production `/library/` route reads. | **fixed** — counts from `allBookIds()`, the same registry the shelf reads. `data/library.ts` untouched. `allBookIds()` rather than `booksData()` because `books-data.ts` imports `nav-data.ts` and calling it there would close an import cycle. |
| Home showed **105 פרקים** while `/neo/books/` showed **135** — same root cause. | fixed in an earlier commit |
| `data/ai-tree/index.json` described book7 with 11 chapters, so ch12 was readable but not retrievable in dev. | fixed in an earlier commit |
